cause: The render path assumed runtimeState was populated even though inbox and cockpit events can run before the asynchronous initial-state response.
prevention: Use one local empty-object fallback for freshness and home summary, preserve a neutral clock and built_at then generated_at precedence, and cover served assets plus desktop and mobile browser flows.
summary: Cockpit rendering could win the initial state fetch and dereference null runtime state in both freshness and home-summary paths, breaking the desktop browser flow before real state arrived.
title: Keep cockpit rendering null-safe before runtime state load
